# DealDrop
> DealDrop is a SaaS price-tracking platform that monitors public product pages and sends price-drop alerts.

## Primary URLs
- https://deals.r6t9.space/
- https://deals.r6t9.space/terms-privacy

## Product Summary
- Track product prices and receive email alerts when prices drop.
- Manage a personal watchlist with price history.
- Uses third-party services for data extraction and email delivery.

## Support
- https://github.com/RexSixT9/dealdrop
